verdict.rationale: Jan documents a built-in local API server that lists models via GET /v1/models, and claims users can "switch freely between local and frontier models." That suggests multiple models are available and switchable in the product. However, nothing explicitly documents loading several models at once or hot-swapping them on the running server without a restart. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-request model selection or hot model load/unload on the running server, concurrent multi-model loading, any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and switch between multiple models without restarting the server

citations.quote: No vendor lock-in: Switch freely between local and frontier models.
Jan provides a built-in, OpenAI-compatible API server that runs entirely on your computer, powered by `llama.cpp`.
